note: Both sets capture the core facts (Nitinol wire actuator, horizontal louvers, rotational movement, 20% glazing of the southern façade, latent solar energy, no additional energy sources), but A repeats the 20% figure three times with two of those claims misbound to the screens' own 'coverage/composition' and adds a claim whose condition ('Phototrophic movement') is attached to the wrong sentence, plus garbled/truncated quotes. A does uniquely and correctly record that Flexinol® wire is a shape memory alloy and a trade name for Nitinol, which B omits entirely. B is cleaner overall but still misstates the 20% figure as an 'operable glazing area' of the façade and repeats the actuation claim, and its quote says 'southern façade' where the text says 'south façade'. On balance B has fewer misbound and unsupported claims, though it is less complete on the material facts.
